task_description: Build a lightweight LoL Match History Tracker - a Next.js web app that allows players to look up their Riot ID (GameName#Tag) and view their last 10 matches with KDA, champion, win/loss, and game duration displayed in a clean, responsive dashboard.

verification.summary: npm run build succeeds with / as static and /api/riot as dynamic. npm run lint passes with zero errors. Semantic review (v2) APPROVED with two non-blocking observations (JSON parse edge case, serverless cache cold starts).
